decision.observation: After pressing Return on 'START GAME', the screen has transitioned to a 'Select Profile' screen showing four save slots numbered 1 through 4. Slot 1 on the left is populated with a save file showing: a white horned character icon at top, six charm/ability icons in a row, health indicator showing 5 masks, two resource counters both showing '0', a circular map or world view in the center showing interconnected areas, location text reading '1H 31M' (play time) and 'MOSS GROTTO' (current location), and completion percentage '1%' at bottom. At the bottom of slot 1 are three small icons: a circular arrow (likely reset/reload), a crescent moon (possibly sleep/rest mode), and a trash can (delete). Slots 2, 3, and 4 are empty and show only their numbers. Background shows dark atmospheric scene with orange ember particles. Title 'SELECT PROFILE' at top with decorative elements.
decision.hypothesis: The save file selection screen confirms that game progress was saved when quitting. Slot 1 shows the save from the previous exploration session with 1 hour 31 minutes played, currently at 'Moss Grotto' location with 1% completion, 5 health masks, 0 currency/resources, and 6 charm slots visible. The extremely low 1% completion percentage strongly suggests that the accessible area explored represents only a tiny fraction of the total game, and that progression mechanisms exist but were not discovered in the starting zone. Should select slot 1 to reload the save and continue exploration with renewed focus on finding hidden routes such as breakable walls, wall-jump sequences, off-screen passages, or interaction methods not yet tested.
